title: Where Does Long-Context Supervision Actually Go? Effective-Context Exposure Balancing
abstract: arXiv:2605.10544v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Long-context adaptation is often viewed as window scaling, but this misses a token-level supervision mismatch: in packed training with document masking, each target token's effective context remains short. We introduce EXACT, a supervision-allocation objective that assigns extra weight to long effective-context targets by inverse frequency within the long tail. Across seven Qwen/LLaMA CPT configurations, EXACT improves all 28 trained/extrapolated NoLiMa and RULER comparisons. On Qwen2.5-0.5B, NoLiMa improves by +10.09 (trained) and +5.34 (extrapolated); RULER by +10.69 and +5.55. On LLaMA-3.2-3B, RULER improves by +17.91 and +16.11. Standard QA/reasoning are preserved (+0.24 macro change across six benchmarks). A distance-resolved probe shows gains arise when evidence is thousands of tokens away, while short cases remain unchanged. Results support a supervision-centric thesis: long-context adaptation depends on how strongly training

translated_title: 长上下文监督究竟去了哪里？有效上下文暴露平衡
translated_abstract: 长上下文适应通常被视为窗口扩展，但这忽略了一个词元级别的监督失配问题：在使用文档掩码的打包训练中，每个目标词元的有效上下文实际上仍然很短。我们提出了EXACT，这是一种监督分配目标，通过长尾分布中的逆频率为长有效上下文目标分配额外权重。在七种Qwen/LLaMA CPT配置中，EXACT改进了全部28个训练/外推设置下的NoLiMa和RULER对比结果。在Qwen2.5-0.5B上，NoLiMa提升了+10.09（训练）和+5.34（外推）；RULER提升了+10.69和+5.55。在LLaMA-3.2-3B上，RULER提升了+17.91和+16.11。标准问答/推理能力得到保留（六个基准测试的宏观变化仅为+0.24）。距离分辨探测显示，收益主要出现在证据相隔数千个词元的情形，而短距离案例保持不变。结果支持一个以监督为中心的论点：长上下文适应取决于训练中……
tldr: 长上下文能力的关键不在于扩大窗口，而在于监督分配——EXACT方法通过逆频率为长有效上下文目标词元加权，在多个模型上显著提升长距离检索性能，同时不损害常规问答与推理能力。
en_tdlr: Long-context adaptation hinges on supervision allocation rather than window scaling—EXACT upweights long effective-context target tokens via inverse frequency, improving NoLiMa and RULER scores across Qwen/LLaMA models while preserving standard QA and reasoning performance.
